The Public Mental Health Partnership (PMHP) within the UCLA Health Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior advances healthy equity through training, consultation, and evaluation of behavioral health programs throughout California. PMHP supports a variety of statewide initiatives, including Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) and Forensic ACT (FACT) programs that improve access to high-quality behavioral health services.

We are seeking a Center Operations Coordinator to provide administrative, operational and program coordination support across PMHP initiatives. This role serves as a central point of coordination for recruitment activities, center operations, communications, meetings, and special projects while working closely with leadership, program staff, and external partners. Key responsibilities include:
Coordinate recruitment, hiring, and onboarding activities, including interview scheduling, documentation, tracking, and follow-up
Support multiple concurrent projects, operational priorities, and administrative workflows
Serve as a central point of contact for center communications, scheduling, and coordination activities
Organize meetings, trainings, and events, including logistics, materials, and documentation
Maintain tracking systems, databases, templates, and operational records
Collaborate with center leadership and departmental partners to improve processes and ensure efficient operations
The salary offered will be determined based on qualifications, experience, internal equity, and other business considerations.
5 or more years or progressively responsible administrative, operational, program coordination, recruitment support, or office management support
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, calendaring systems, databases, and virtual meeting platforms
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and handle confidential information
